## Description

Random variates from the multivariate Gaussian distribution in R [@RCoreTeam-2026]
using the Cholesky, eigen, or singular value decomposition
of the covariance matrix.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `randomGaussian` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/ijapesigan/randomGaussian) with:

```r
if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ijapesigan/randomGaussian")
```

## Example

```{r}
library(package = "randomGaussian")
```

A covariance matrix and a mean vector of three variables.

```{r}
k <- 3
sigma <- stats::toeplitz(x = (k:1) / k)
mu <- c(1, 2, 3)
sigma
```

`RandomGaussian()` draws `n` rows
using the Cholesky decomposition by default.
The `decomposition` argument also accepts `"eigen"` and `"svd"`,
which work for positive semi-definite covariance matrices.

```{r}
set.seed(seed = 42)
x <- RandomGaussian(n = 10000, Sigma = sigma, mu = mu)
utils::head(x = x)
colMeans(x = x)
stats::cov(x = x)
```

```{r}
x_eigen <- RandomGaussian(
  n = 10000,
  Sigma = sigma,
  mu = mu,
  decomposition = "eigen"
)
colMeans(x = x_eigen)
stats::cov(x = x_eigen)
```
